verdict.rationale: Circle is clearly API-first. It offers REST APIs and SDKs to create wallets, sign transactions and authorize actions, plus per-product OpenAPI specs (compliance, gateway), webhooks and idempotency keys. A CLI also covers wallet management, transfers, swaps, bridging and contract execution. However, nothing in the pack states that the API matches the console/UI, and some flows appear to depend on account or console steps: setting gas policies and paying gas by credit card, and applying for a Circle Mint account. A consolidated OpenAPI spec was also not found at the standard discovery paths. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, evidence that console-only functions (gas policy and billing setup, Mint onboarding, account administration) are API-accessible, a discoverable unified OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
